node_version.reason: ChatGPT and Codex must use identical Node/Next versions to prevent drift.

next_version.reason: All code must be generated for Next.js 16 only.

prevent_structure_drift.reason: Folder structure must never change unless explicitly updated in website_instructions.md.

cta_flow.reason: WhatsApp must be the only consistent order CTA across desktop & mobile.

text_safety.reason: Garbled characters break trust, SEO, and brand quality.

typescript.reason: Data in items.json is the source of truth; type drift must not happen.

items_json_source_of_truth.reason: All pricing, units, features, specs, and CTAs must derive from items.json.

seo_metadata.reason: SEO must be correct from day one.

ssr_navigation.reason: Navigation and layout must be SSR for SEO + performance.

pwa_strategy.reason: Prevent broken PWA builds with unsupported hybrid configs.

performance.reason: Website must be mobile-first and extremely fast.

product_card_rules.reason: All product cards must have a consistent ecommerce look.

notes: This codex.json binds ChatGPT and VSCode Codex to the rulebook defined in website_instructions.md.
Any code generation must comply with all rules listed here.
Any deviation or violation must trigger warnings or blocking behavior in development.
